standard-dialogue.prompt: Do you want to talk about lamps?

steps.player: Hi, I need fuel for a lamp.

steps.npc: Hello there, the fuel you need is lamp oil, do you need help making it?
It's really quite simple.  You use the small still in here.  It's all set up, so there's no fiddling around with dials...
Just put ordinary swamp tar in, and then use a lantern or lamp to get the oil out.
Good to hear, sorry but I have a few things to do right now.

steps.player: Well I'd better let you get on then.

options.text: No, I'm more interested in impling jars.

steps.player: I have a slightly odd question.

steps.npc: Jolly good, the odder the better. I like oddities.

steps.player: Do you know how I might distil a mix of anchovy oil and flowers so that it forms a layer on the inside of a butterfly jar?

steps.npc: That is an odd question. I commend you for it. Why would you want to do that?

steps.player: Apparently, if I can make a jar like this it will be useful for storing implings in.

steps.npc: So, do you have any of this fish-and-flower flavoured oil and a butterfly jar then?

steps.text: If the player has Imp repellent and a butterfly jar in their inventory:

steps.npc: Well then. Hmmm. My lamp oil still may be able to do what you want. Give it a go and see if it works.
If you go and get them then I may be able to help you. I'm better at coming up with answers if the questions are in my hands.

steps.prompt: Is there anything else you want to ask?

options.text: So how do you make anchovy oil?

steps.player: So, how do you make anchovy oil?

steps.npc: Anchovies are pretty oily fish. I'd have thought you could just grind them up and sieve out the bits. You'd probably want to remove any water first - Cooking should do that pretty well.

options.text: Do you have a sieve I can use?

steps.player: Do you have a sieve I can use?

steps.text: If the player has a sieve in their inventory:

steps.npc: Errm, yes. But you already have one. Two sieves is a bit excessive, don't you think?

steps.text: If the player has a sieve in their bank:

steps.npc: Are you sure you don't already have one?

steps.text: You already have a sieve that will do the job in your bank.

steps.npc: Errm, yes. Here, have this one. It's only been used for sieving dead rats out of sewer water.

steps.player: Err, why? Actually, on second thoughts I don't want to know.

steps.npc: Well, it should be ideally suited to your task.

options.text: I'd better go and get the repellent.

steps.player: I'd better go and get the repellent.
